newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina and IADB to sign loan deals next week.
newsitem.headline: Argentina and IADB to sign loan deals next week.

text.p: Argentina's Economy Minister Roque Fernandez and the head of the Inter-American Development Bank (IADB) are set to sign three loan agreements next week, the Economy Ministry announced Tuesday.

Enrique Iglesias, president of the IADB and Fernandez will sign an agreement on August 4 for a loan of $104 million destined to finance modernization of Argentina's ports, the ministry statement said.

They will also sign a deal for a $370 million loan destined to help youth employment in the country on Monday. This loan has not yet been appproved by the IADB. IADB directors will meet to discuss the loan on August 1, the statement said.
On August 5 another loan to the province of Buenos Aires worth $350 million will be signed.
